name: Shop Information System
author: Fahad Mahmood

sections.description:
• Author: Fahad Mahmood
  • Demo URI: http://demo.androidbubble.com/please-wait/
    Shop Information System facilitates price adjustment of products in bulk as per given values. You can increase/decrease price as flat rate and discount based. You can also select products, price and other parameters to see sales history on graphs. You can normalize price as per previous price history and reset price to last updated price, you can go back to the last entry in price history.

Overview

  • Price adjustment of products in bulk
  • Increase prices as percentage/flat rate
  • Decrease prices as percentage/flat rate
  • Shop analysis > Product sales, Product prices
  • Normalize price as per previous history

sections.installation:
From the WordPress plugin menu click on Add New and search for Shop Information System
Instead of searching for a plugin you can directly upload the plugin zip file by clicking on Upload:
Use the browse button to select the plugin zip file that was downloaded, then click on Install Now. The plugin will be uploaded to your blog and installed. It can then be activated.
“Shop Information System” is available under WooCommerce.
sections.faq:
How to adjust prices of products using this plugin?

Select “Adjustment” then select adjustment by flat/percentage. Select increase/decrease, enter price/percentage and Update.

What is normalize button do?

Normalize button allow you to set average prices as per pervious history.

How to reset prices and how many times it could be?

Select “Reset” and press update, system will undo price to last price, it can undo till last entry in price history.

What if I decrease price and one or more products price might become 0 or less?

In this case you will see warning as you enter amount in Price Adjustment box even if you do not select any product.

If one or more products are on sale already what will happen after changing price?

One or more products are on sale and new price is greater than or equal to regular price, so products are removed from sale and use regular price for future.

Uninstalling Shop Information System

Uninstalling removes the plugin settings, redirect rules, monitoring log and the generated sitemap. Product price history is stored in your product data and is kept, and files in your WordPress library are not touched.
sections.changelog:
1.3.0

  • Security: capability checks added to every AJAX action (price changes, sitemap, statistics, settings, redirects, traffic monitoring).
  • Security: stored XSS fixed in the traffic monitoring list, redirects editor, Yoast explorer and product tables; all output is now escaped.
  • Security: all SQL queries now use prepared statements or cast identifiers; the debug output that exposed server variables was removed.
  • Security: sales statistics in the admin bar and in the shortcode are limited to shop managers and administrators.
  • Fix: “Percentage” in Force Update was rejected by the server.
  • Fix: traffic monitoring log is bounded and stored without autoload.
  • Fix: redirects no longer run inside wp-admin, AJAX, REST or cron requests; the target must be a path or an http(s) address.
  • Fix: sitemap URLs and images are resolved on the server from the product ids.
  • Usability: Force Update asks for confirmation; redirects tab explains the rule format; missing WooCommerce is explained instead of breaking tabs; settings link works with or without WooCommerce; more strings are translatable.
  • Pro features now live in the /pro directory (remote API, quarterly report, orders date filter). That directory is not part of the WordPress.org build.
  • Tested up to WordPress 7.1; requires WordPress 6.5 and PHP 7.4.
  • Plugin assets (banner and icon) added for WordPress.org.

1.2.0

  • Dashboard, Yoast keywords explorer, products image linker, products sitemap generator and 404 redirects.

1.1.7

  • Improvement: Enhanced bulk price updates with stronger security checks, batch ownership validation, and improved processing reliability. [06/04/2026]

1.1.4

  • New: Added automated sitemap generation with dynamic product priorities, full-resolution images, and updated timestamps for better Google crawling. [05/03/2026]

  • New: Automatic quarterly email report generation added (WooCommerce order summary by state).

  • New: Activation and deactivation hooks added to manage cron event registration.
